title: The Island
description:
S01 E05 — Rebellion
Local authorities introduce strict precautions; Herm and Evelin scheme against their parents in the name of love, but this leads to disaster as the virus claims another victim.

title: The Island
description:
S01 E06 — Besieged
As Mikkel loses control of the island, people ignore the restrictions and events begin to spiral out of control.

title: Tales From The Void
description:
S01 E06 — Whistle in the Woods
Sawyer is beyond excited to visit her new friend Nola and her elation ratchets up a notch when she arrives at Nola's house.

title: The Trouble With Tessa
description:
S01 E06 — Part Six: Troubles
Tessa seizes a narrow, brutal chance at freedom; the town's warning siren leaves them with no choice but to return to where everything began; once inside, Tessa finally learns the truth they've been chasing all along.

title: Babysitter Must Die
description: Members of a cult invade the home of a wealthy family, but they didn't count on a resourceful babysitter who's armed with a variety of weapons.

title: Hell House LLC II: The Abaddon Hotel
description: Eight years after a hotel's tragic opening, an investigative journalist is convinced key evidence remains in the abandoned hotel. She assembles a team to help her break into the building to find the truth and shed light on the mystery.

description: A host takes his show into an abandoned hotel that is rumored to be haunted.

title: The Innkeepers

title: Heavy Trip
description: A young man is trying to overcome his fears by leading an unknown heavy metal band to the hottest metal festival in Norway. The journey includes heavy metal, grave robbing, Viking heaven, and an armed conflict between Finland and Norway.

title: The Beyond
description: Gruesome deaths occur when a woman (Katherine MacColl) inherits a hotel that is one of seven gateways to hell.
